# AddressRedundancyElimination

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A technique in neuromorphic systems that removes redundant address information from spike packets to reduce communication overhead and improve processing efficiency. This directly addresses a key bottleneck in SNN acceleration, enabling higher throughput and lower latency in iNEST-based neuromorphic computing.
